required: D8-01 minimum list and Disposition 05 F1 table, per typed scan trigger (other-G entry sorted first and last, G record, event file)
current-G wrong bytes + scan unavailability -> FAILED_VERIFICATION; retry never PASS
marker mismatch + scan unavailability (and + current-G entry unavailable) -> FAILED_VERIFICATION
earlier-sorting unavailable entry + later consistency mismatch -> FAILED_VERIFICATION; repairing the unavailable entry never yields PASS
event-file or G-record unavailability + another registry mismatch -> FAILED_VERIFICATION
current-G entry unavailable + another registry mismatch -> FAILED_VERIFICATION
unavailability with no mismatch anywhere -> UNAVAILABLE, then PASS after exact restoration
registered_producers contract, DV8-3 no-new-read check and DV8-4
S7-IQ-F2: protected-entry and _preconditions unavailability -> REFUSED_PRECONDITION with the typed Unavailable propagated; verification-phase unavailability -> UNAVAILABLE
prohibitions on every path: no generation, entropy, salt, native execution or registration

F1_ordering: current-G registry mismatch -> FAILED_VERIFICATION (checked first, never dependent on the scan)
other available registry-entry consistency/identity mismatch -> FAILED_VERIFICATION
event/registry unavailability with no available positive mismatch -> UNAVAILABLE
no mismatch and no unavailability -> normal processing
recovery: a pure availability condition may recover only when the exact unavailable evidence returns
a discovered positive mismatch stays terminal through the existing 'already failed' refusal; repairing an unrelated unavailable condition never yields PASS
a REFUSED_PRECONDITION from protected-entry unavailability is non-terminal
registered_producers_contract: no mapped read unavailable: identical to the Seal-07 scan (result, exception, message, reads)
a mapped read unavailable: the Seal-07 result (the first ProducerRegistryUnavailable) unless a positive mismatch is found later, in which case that IntegrityError raises
single-condition semantics preserved: mismatch alone, unavailable alone, valid registry
no replacement evidence, no inference about unavailable contents, no weakened check
